direct_official_checks: OSGM15 converts ETRS89 heights to orthometric datum heights
OSGM15 supplies ODN on mainland Great Britain
values are obtained by bilinear interpolation
nominal mainland geoid-model accuracy is 8mm RMS
other areas have different nominal accuracy
OS recommends OSGM15 with OS Net for high-accuracy orthometric heighting
OSGM15 datum-model error must remain separate from terrain-surface model error
quality_effect: Separates vertical datum transformation uncertainty from EA and Terrain50 terrain-model uncertainty.
